title: He offered up each of his three daily chaplets that his soul might grow strong in each of the three theological virtues,
html_source: Stephen has turned religion into a strict pattern of living. The numbers Three and Seven repeat themselves in the chapter and his life.

anchor.text: He offered up each of his three daily chaplets that his soul might grow strong in each of the three theological virtues,
anchor.prefix: em as he walked the streets—transformed themselves into coronals of flowers of such vague unearthly texture that they seemed to him as hueless and odourless as they were nameless.
anchor.suffix: in faith in the Father Who had created him, in hope in the Son Who had redeemed him and in love of the Holy Ghost Who had sanctified him; and this thrice triple prayer he offered
anchor.canonical_text: He offered up each of his three daily chaplets that his soul might grow strong in each of the three theological virtues,
